intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Ukraine and Russia agree a big prisoner swap
items.text: Russia and Ukraine have agreed in principle to a large exchange of prisoners after talks in Abu Dhabi, which the United States helped to arrange. The swap could take place in two or three weeks, but the number of people involved has not been settled. Jared Kushner said the sides would finalise the numbers the next day. The talks did not produce a breakthrough on ending the war. Kyiv says it will not give up occupied land, while Moscow wants the rest of the Donetsk region.

gloss.in principle: in general, before the details are fixed
gloss.prisoner exchange: an agreement where each side frees prisoners
gloss.finalise: to make something fully agreed and complete
gloss.breakthrough: an important step forward after a long difficulty

items.title: Leaders gather for COP31 climate talks in Antalya
items.text: Ninety-one national leaders have travelled to the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey. US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping did not attend. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has proposed a tax on the extra profits that some companies have made because of the war involving Iran. Delegates are now trying to agree on how countries should cut their emissions and pay for the change.

gloss.windfall profit: a sudden, large profit that a company did not plan for
gloss.emissions: gases, such as carbon dioxide, released into the air
gloss.delegate: a person sent to speak for a group or country
gloss.attend: to be present at an event

items.title: UK names its first climate security envoy
items.text: Dame Madeleine Alessandri has been appointed Britain's first special representative for climate security. Prime Minister Andy Burnham is expected to announce the role at the COP31 summit in Turkey. The job is meant to link the effects of climate change with questions of national and international safety, such as shortages of food and water. The appointment comes as world leaders discuss how to respond to rising global temperatures.

gloss.envoy: an official who represents a government abroad
gloss.appoint: to choose someone officially for a job
gloss.shortage: a situation where there is not enough of something
gloss.link: to connect one thing with another

items.title: England make late changes before Croatia game
items.text: England face Croatia at Wembley on Thursday, and manager Thomas Tuchel has had to change his squad. Bournemouth defender James Hill, 24, has received his first senior call-up. Marc Guehi has pulled out with an injury after he came off at half-time in Manchester City's match at Nottingham Forest. Newcastle's Dan Burn, who has 11 caps, has joined the group instead. Ezri Konsa will miss the match but should return to training later this week.

gloss.call-up: an invitation to join a national team
gloss.pull out: to decide not to take part
gloss.come off: to leave the pitch during a match
gloss.cap: an appearance for your country's national team
gloss.squad: the group of players chosen for a team

items.title: Sinner misses ATP Finals as Turin line-up is set
items.text: Defending champion Jannik Sinner will not play at the ATP Finals in Turin because of a knee injury. He has not played since Wimbledon in July and hopes to return for the Australian Open in January. World number one Alexander Zverev leads the field of eight, which includes Carlos Alcaraz, Daniil Medvedev and Ben Shelton. Four players are making their debut, among them Italy's Flavio Cobolli. The round-robin matches begin on Sunday and the final is on 22 November.

gloss.defending champion: the player who won the title last time
gloss.round robin: a stage where every player plays everyone in their group
gloss.debut: the first time someone takes part
gloss.field: all the players in a competition
gloss.qualify: to earn a place in an event

items.title: Brazil fines Meta over 7 million reais
items.text: Brazil's electoral court has fined Meta 7.5 million reais, which is about $1.34 million. The court is the body that oversees elections in the country. The fine was reported on Thursday in a morning news round-up. Large technology firms often face rules and penalties in Brazil, where courts have taken a firm approach to online platforms. Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.

gloss.fine: to make someone pay money as a punishment
gloss.electoral court: a court that deals with election rules
gloss.penalty: a punishment for breaking a rule
gloss.platform: a website or app where people share content

items.title: Ebola cases pass 11,000 in DR Congo
items.text: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has passed 11,000, according to a morning news briefing. The outbreak is now among the largest ever recorded for the disease. Ebola spreads through contact with the body fluids of infected people and can be deadly. Health workers continue to track new cases and try to stop the virus from spreading further.

gloss.outbreak: a sudden rise in cases of a disease
gloss.confirmed: proven to be true, for example by a test
gloss.body fluids: liquids from the body, such as blood

items.title: Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala to headline Coachella
items.text: Coachella has announced its headliners for 2027. Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala will top the bill at the music festival in California. Coachella is one of the biggest events in the music calendar, and tickets usually sell quickly. Fans will now wait for the full line-up of artists, which is normally published after the headliners are named.

gloss.headliner: the main act at a concert or festival
gloss.line-up: the list of performers at an event
gloss.announce: to tell the public something officially
gloss.sell quickly: to be bought in a short time

items.title: Gold slips below $4,000 and the yen weakens
items.text: The price of gold has fallen below $4,000 an ounce, according to a morning market briefing. At the same time, the Japanese yen has dropped to a two-month low. Investors often buy gold when they are worried about the economy, so a fall can show that some of that fear is easing. Traders will watch whether the price recovers or falls further in the coming days.

gloss.ounce: a unit of weight, about 28 grams
gloss.investor: a person who puts money into something to make a profit
gloss.ease: to become less strong or serious
gloss.recover: to go back up after a fall

items.title: GTA VI to run at 30 frames per second on consoles
items.text: Rockstar Games has said Grand Theft Auto VI will target 30 frames per second on all consoles when it launches on Thursday 19 November. PS5 Pro players will get sharper pictures through PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows. Preloading started on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S this week. PlayStation and Microsoft both say the game is the most pre-ordered title in their stores' history. There will be no disc, only a download code in the box.

gloss.frame rate: how many pictures a game shows each second
gloss.preload: to download a game before it is released
gloss.pre-order: to buy something before it is on sale
gloss.ray-traced: using a technique that makes light and shadows look realistic
gloss.upscaling: making an image look sharper on a screen
